title: fix(audio): select the intended executable through symlinked PATH entries
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes local audio transcription selecting the wrong executable when a home-relative PATH entry traverses a symlink followed by `..`.

## User Impact

Local audio uses the executable reached by the configured PATH entry, preserving its precedence over lexical and later PATH decoys. Home directories containing the platform PATH delimiter remain intact. No configuration migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Local audio now uses the shared executable resolver instead of maintaining a second lookup and cache. Home expansion passes prepared directory entries so delimiter characters and filesystem traversal semantics survive resolution. The change retains the existing empty-entry and cache-invalidation contracts.

## Evidence

- Exact candidate: `093cfd4b89a29da530ef3e7a75993e2d151c9d27`, preserving original candidate `4e924e3b9a8a444813896d4bbecc06ad35636c00` and integrating frozen main `9564dd651472dc639e6114bee67c5d5f152d9fce`.
- Five-file independent review completed. Six observations reduced to three existing contracts and were rejected after tracing explicit Windows batch invocation, intentional empty-PATH handling, and configuration-owned cache invalidation.
- The CLI regression selected the lexical decoy with frozen-main production code and the intended executable with the candidate.
- Focused macOS proof: 50 tests passed; two native-Windows checks skipped. The reviewed source inputs are unchanged, so this accepted proof was reused.
- Post-integration `check:changed` passed, including the five-file line-cap ratchet, formatting, core production and all 27 core-test type graphs, lint, and native guards.

Measured macOS wall times from the accepted October 1 focused run (one selected file per native runner shard, including startup/import overhead):

| Test file | Wall time |
| --- | ---: |
| `src/cli/capability-local-audio-path.process.test.ts` | 3.688 s |
| `src/infra/executable-path.test.ts` | 1.673 s |
| `src/media-understanding/local-audio.test.ts` | 15.577 s |

Native review and preparation completed at the exact candidate above. [Current-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36862120469), including the Windows lanes, and the separate [security review gate](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36863531226) passed. Native squash auto-merge landed [34aff4fa8e91](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/34aff4fa8e919ee1a08dbbfcc3f2bdd0e07faca3); the landed five-file diff matches the reviewed patch exactly, and main ancestry was verified. [Native closeout completed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162680#issuecomment-5931778587). Native Windows execution and fresh speech-model inference are not established by the current macOS synthetic-executable proof.
